summary: Baytex Energy Corp. furnished a routine Form 6-K containing its Q3 2026 interim financial statements, MD&A, CEO/CFO certifications, a results press release with an increased 2026 capital plan and 2027 guidance, and a notice of a quarterly dividend payable January 2027. No special-situations transaction is disclosed; this is an ordinary foreign-private-issuer quarterly reporting package mapped to a US domestic quarterly earnings filing. Balance-sheet notes reference minor assets held for sale and no deal terms. Watch only for capital-plan and dividend cadence implications, not event-driven arbitrage.
